tasks.description: Implement **Task 1: Host-side URL credentialing helper (tokens.py)** of the napkin/taskdef plan. The COMPLETE task — exact code, exact tests, step-by-step TDD — is in `docs/masterplan/napkin-taskdef-repos/plan.md` under the heading `### Task 1:`. Read that section AND the `## Global Constraints` section at the top of plan.md first, then implement every Step in order. Summary: add a `dedicated_env` keyword to `_get_gitlab_token` (checked first) and a new `_credential_repo_url(url, *, dedicated_env=None)` that bakes an oauth2 token into an SSH or HTTPS git URL, reusing `_prefer_ssh`/`urlparse`. All file paths in the plan are relative to your current working directory (the repo root). CRITICAL deviations from the plan text: (a) DO NOT run any `git add`/`git commit` step — the orchestrator commits after you finish; (b) DO NOT run the `make test` full-suite step — run ONLY the targeted verify command for this task; (c) stay strictly within your declared files. When done, `tests/test_lmer_cli_token_injection.py` must contain the new test classes and `src/lmer_cli/tokens.py` the new code, and the verify command must pass on real output.

Implement **Task 2: Host CLI — resolve repos, compute napkin path, declare env vars (cli.py)** of the napkin/taskdef plan. The COMPLETE task — exact code, exact tests, step-by-step TDD — is in `docs/masterplan/napkin-taskdef-repos/plan.md` under the heading `### Task 2:`. Read that section AND the `## Global Constraints` section first, then implement every Step in order. Summary: import `_credential_repo_url`, add a module-level `_resolve_napkin_path(napkin_repo_url, work_repo_path)`, credential the optional napkin/taskdef URLs host-side in `main()`, compute the napkin path, append `/taskdef` to `container_taskdef_paths`, and declare `LMER_NAPKIN_REPO`/`LMER_NAPKIN_PATH`/`LMER_TASKDEF_REPO`/`LMER_TASKDEF_REF` in the inline env dict with the two `*_TOKEN` vars seeded `None` (so the .env merge cannot leak them). This task depends on Task 1's `_credential_repo_url` already existing. Insertion points cite line numbers in the plan — find the matching anchor code rather than trusting the exact line. All paths are relative to your cwd (repo root). CRITICAL: (a) NO git add/commit; (b) NO `make test` full-suite step — run ONLY the targeted verify; (c) stay within declared files. Verify must pass on real output.

Implement **Task 3: Container entrypoint — clone repos and create symlinks (clone_and_exec.py)** of the napkin/taskdef plan. The COMPLETE task — exact code, exact tests, step-by-step TDD — is in `docs/masterplan/napkin-taskdef-repos/plan.md` under the heading `### Task 3:`. Read that section AND the `## Global Constraints` section first, then implement every Step in order. Summary: add three stdlib-only helpers to the standalone `clone_and_exec.py` — `clone_aux_repos`, `link_into_home`, `setup_napkin_and_links` — and call them in `main()` after the `provision_documentation(...)` block and before the `# Dispatch` comment. Create the NEW test file `tests/test_clone_and_exec_aux_repos.py` exactly as written. The module must NOT import from `lmer_cli`/`work_repo` (stdlib only; `shutil` is already imported). All paths relative to your cwd (repo root). CRITICAL: (a) NO git add/commit; (b) NO `make test` full-suite step — run ONLY the targeted verify; (c) stay within declared files. Verify must pass on real output.

Implement **Task 4: Napkin push in separate-repo mode (work_repo)** of the napkin/taskdef plan. The COMPLETE task — exact code, exact tests, step-by-step TDD — is in `docs/masterplan/napkin-taskdef-repos/plan.md` under the heading `### Task 4:`. Read that section AND the `## Global Constraints` section first, then implement every Step in order. Summary: add `push_napkin_if_separate(commit_message=None)` to `src/work_repo/git_ops.py` (fetch→pull→add→commit→push against the napkin repo, but only when `LMER_NAPKIN_PATH` is a git repo OUTSIDE `LMER_WORK_REPO_PATH`; best-effort), then wire it non-fatally into `cmd_commit` in `src/work_repo/cli.py` (extend the `from .git_ops import ...` line). Add the new test classes to `tests/test_work_repo_git_ops.py` and `tests/test_work_repo_cli.py`. All paths relative to your cwd (repo root). CRITICAL: (a) NO git add/commit; (b) NO `make test` full-suite step — run ONLY the targeted verify; (c) stay within declared files. Verify must pass on real output.

Implement **Task 5: Document the new env vars (docs/LMER-CLI.md)** of the napkin/taskdef plan. The COMPLETE task — exact markdown bullets to add — is in `docs/masterplan/napkin-taskdef-repos/plan.md` under the heading `### Task 5:`. Read that section, then insert the six env-var bullets (`LMER_NAPKIN_REPO`, `LMER_NAPKIN_TOKEN`, `LMER_NAPKIN_PATH`, `LMER_TASKDEF_REPO`, `LMER_TASKDEF_TOKEN`, `LMER_TASKDEF_REF`) verbatim into `docs/LMER-CLI.md`, immediately after the `LMER_WORK_REPO_PATH` bullet in the `#### LMER-Specific Environment Variables` section. Documentation-only; no code, no tests. All paths relative to your cwd (repo root). CRITICAL: (a) NO git add/commit; (b) stay within the single declared file. Verify must pass on real output.
verify_commands: grep -q LMER_NAPKIN_REPO docs/LMER-CLI.md && grep -q LMER_TASKDEF_REF docs/LMER-CLI.md && grep -q LMER_NAPKIN_PATH docs/LMER-CLI.md
